business_overview.one_sentence: 集团为投资控股公司，业务包括医疗产品与塑料玩具制造销售、证券经纪/资产管理/孖展融资、放贷及其他金融服务，并持有投资物业和上市证券投资组合。

segments.name: Medical products and plastic toys business
segments.source: Annual report 2025 note 6, pp.77-78, HK$000 converted to HKD

segments.name: Securities brokerage business and asset management services
segments.source: Annual report 2025 note 6, pp.77-78, HK$000 converted to HKD

segments.name: Money lending business and other financial services
segments.source: Annual report 2025 note 6, pp.77-78, HK$000 converted to HKD

business_overview.revenue_model: 产品销售在交付时确认；证券经纪按交易日确认佣金；贷款与孖展融资产生利息收入。
business_notes: 医疗产品客户通常 30 天账期，塑料玩具客户 30-90 天账期。
2025 年税前利润主要受贷款减值转回和 FVTPL 金融资产公允价值收益影响。
证券经纪客户资金为信托/隔离账户资金，不能用于集团自身义务。

non_recurring_items.item: fair value gains on financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: FVTPL 投资公允价值收益，不代表经营现金利润
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2025 cash flow statement p.51 and note 23 p.98

non_recurring_items.item: reversal of impairment loss on financial assets at amortised cost
non_recurring_items.business_substance: 贷款、孖展和其他应收减值转回，主要来自放贷业务，不代表新创造现金利润
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2025 income statement p.46 and note 6 p.82

non_recurring_items.item: gain on disposal of subsidiaries, net
non_recurring_items.business_substance: 出售子公司收益，一次性项目
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2025 cash flow statement p.51 and note 30 pp.105-106

non_recurring_items.item: loss on early redemption of bonds
non_recurring_items.business_substance: 债券提前赎回损失，一次性融资项目
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2025 cash flow statement p.51 and note 26/30

funds_assets.item: bank balances - house and general accounts and cash
funds_assets.business_substance: 集团自有现金及一般账户银行结余；币种包含 RMB/HKD/USD，部分在内地，需保留经营现金并折扣
funds_assets.source: Annual report 2025 p.48 and note 24 p.99

funds_assets.item: bank balances - trust and segregated client accounts
funds_assets.business_substance: 证券业务客户资金，对应客户应付款，集团无权抵销或自用
funds_assets.source: Annual report 2025 note 24 p.99 and note 25 p.100

funds_assets.item: financial assets at FVTPL - HK listed equities
funds_assets.business_substance: 香港上市证券投资组合，流动性较好但有市场波动，属于金融投资资产

funds_assets.item: financial assets at FVTPL - unlisted debt securities
funds_assets.business_substance: 非上市债务证券，流动性和可回收性不明

funds_assets.item: financial assets at FVTPL - unlisted equity fund
funds_assets.business_substance: 非上市权益基金，长期投资属性，流动性弱

operating_assets.business_substance: 制造业务原材料、在产品和产成品

years.note: 经营现金流主要来自贷款应收减少 282.067m，不能视作持续利润现金化。
经营现金流同样主要来自贷款应收减少 335.716m。
2025 年报财务摘要披露 2023 年归母亏损，但未抽到完整现金流。

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025/2024 经营现金流为正主要是金融资产收缩和贷款收回；2025 报表盈利剔除 FVTPL 公允价值收益、贷款减值转回和处置收益后为负。
